header: The years the studio changed shape
subheadline: Three moments that took Atlas Studio from a two-desk operation to three cities and a research tool of its own. Everything between them was client work, which is roughly how a design studio is supposed to spend a decade.

milestones.title: The Berlin studio opens
milestones.description: Six designers moved onto a shared floor on Oranienstraße to sit within walking distance of the Kestrel Bank product teams.

milestones.title: Fieldnote raises EUR 2.1 million
milestones.description: The research repository we had built for our own field studies spun out in September with eight paying studios already on it.

milestones.title: The fortieth product ships
milestones.description: The Vireo Health patient portal went live in 11 countries and took the studio past 40 shipped products since 2016.
